author: MarioNawfal
text:
🇮🇳🇷🇺 Indian National Security Advisor Ajit Doval was caught with his hand in the nut jar while Putin was speaking right in front of him.

This is the second time today an Indian official has been seen munching away while a world leader was giving a speech.

But Putin?

You gotta be...nuts.

Writer: Marie
